WEBSITE PRIVACY

Your trip details stay in your control.

You choose whether to send an enquiry. This website does not take payments or automatically send a booking message.

Details you enter

Your browser may keep trip selections and form details in this tab’s session storage, so you can move between trip and vehicle pages. This site has no customer account or booking database.

When you open WhatsApp

The details you choose are placed into a WhatsApp draft link. Opening it shares that draft information with WhatsApp; you still check it and tap Send yourself. Only include details needed to plan the trip. Payment and any booking changes are handled directly with the owner.

Optional Google Analytics

Analytics is off until you choose Allow cookies. If you allow it, Google Analytics measures page visits and clicks to call us or open WhatsApp. These clicks show interest, not a confirmed booking or a sent message. Google may process online identifiers, device and usage information. We do not send your name, phone number, pickup place, trip notes or WhatsApp draft contents to Analytics. Automatic outbound-link and form measurement is disabled.

Advertising consent and Google signals stay off. Analytics cookies are configured to expire after 30 days. Your browser stores your analytics choice for up to 180 days. Use Cookie choices to change your mind; choosing Reject optional cookies stops our tracking and removes this site's Analytics cookies. You can also clear your browser's site storage.

· Google privacy policy

Website delivery

Cloudflare hosts and secures this website and can process connection information, such as IP addresses and technical request information, to deliver it. The website does not use advertising trackers.

Questions about information you shared

Contact Hemanth Kumar on WhatsApp or email heavenlytoursandtravels1@gmail.com to discuss access to or deletion of details you have sent directly to the business.
